title: M-Theory
description: Strings are the edges of membranes in eleven dimensions.

puzzle.goal: Eleven-dimensional gravity compactified on a circle of radius g_s·l_s must reproduce ten-dimensional string gravity. The 10-D inverse coupling 1/(2κ²) = 1/((2π)⁷ g_s² l_s⁸) must equal the 11-D one, 1/((2π)⁸ l₁₁⁹), integrated around the circle's circumference in the extra coordinate y.
puzzle.name: M-theory/type IIA matching (eleven-dimensional Planck length)
puzzle.ask: Solving gives l₁₁ = g_s^(1/3)·l_s. Find l₁₁ (in 10⁻³⁴ m) for g_s = @{gs} and l_s = 3×10⁻³⁴ m.
puzzle.method: Integrating the 11-D action over the compact coordinate multiplies its coefficient by the circumference 2πR; equate the coefficients of the 10-D curvature term and solve for l₁₁.
